title: 第270章 福尔卡来访
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

电话挂断。

杜坚把手机扔在桌上，身子往后一仰，靠在椅背上。

他从兜里摸出烟盒，重新抽出一根放到在嘴里。

赵平安坐在对面，脸色也不好看。

“真派‘深海’过来？”

赵平安压低了声音。

杜坚把烟点上，抽了一大口。

“陈司长亲口说的，还能有假。”

“这下麻烦了。”

赵平安一脸难色。

“张剑这小子吃软不吃硬。”

“‘深海’那帮人又是出了名的百无禁忌。”

“他们要是在巴扎尔甘搞的太过分，张剑能愿意？伊朗这边能愿意？”

杜坚吐出一口青烟。

“这正是我担心的。”

“‘深海’干活，从来不管什么地盘不地盘，也不在乎什么影响。”

“只要是被他们判定为威胁的目标，直接物理清除。”

“张剑手底下这帮人，今天你也看见了，也是一帮桀骜不驯的家伙。”

“这两拨人要是撞上……”

杜坚没往下说。

赵平安抿了抿嘴。

“火星撞地球，咱们夹在中间可就难受了。”

杜坚把抽了一半的烟摁灭在烟灰缸里，站起身。

“不行，不能干等。”

“走，去找张剑透个底。”

“必须得让他先有个心理准备。”

两人出了屋，穿过院子，来到厂房门前。

张剑正坐在厂房前的藤椅上，手里拿着个平板电脑，手指在屏幕上划拉着。

苏莱曼从厂房里出来，手里端着一杯红茶，脸上的表情挺放松。

哈桑和雷子打完之后，两边的气氛反而没那么剑拔弩张了。

看到杜坚和赵平安走过来，张剑抬起头。

“杜队长，住的地方可还行？”

“挺好，谢了。”

杜坚拉了把椅子坐下，没打算绕圈子。

“张老板，有个事儿，我得跟你通个气。”

张剑放下平板，把平板扣在桌面上。

“说。”

杜坚双手交叉放在膝盖上，身体微微前倾。

“刚才我跟国内通了电话。”

“上面对你的安全非常重视。”

“除了我们利刃小队，上面还额外增派了一支队伍过来。”

“算算时间，最迟后天晚上就能到。”

张剑听完，眉毛挑了一下。

“增派人手？”

他接过苏莱曼递过来的茶杯，吹了吹热气。

“好事啊。”

“现在外面盯着我的人不少，多点人手，多份保障。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The phone hangs up.

Du Jian threw his phone on the table, leaned back and leaned on the back of his chair.

He took out the cigarette case from his pocket, took out another one and put it in his mouth.

Zhao Ping'an was sitting opposite, his expression not good-looking.

"Really sent 'Deep Sea' here?"

Zhao Pingan lowered his voice.

Du Jian lit the cigarette and took a long puff.

"Director Chen said it himself, it can still be false."

"This is trouble."

Zhao Ping'an looked embarrassed.

"Zhang Jian, this kid, doesn't like hard work."

"The guys from 'Deep Sea' are famous for having no taboos."

"If they go too far in Bazargan, will Zhang Jian be willing? Will Iran be willing?"

Du Jian blew out a puff of smoke.

"That's what I'm worried about."

"When working in the 'deep sea', we never care about the territory or the impact."

"As long as they determine the target as a threat, they will directly remove it physically."

"You saw Zhang Jianshou's gang today, they are also a bunch of unruly guys."

"If these two groups of people collide..."

Du Jian said nothing further.

Zhao Pingan pursed his lips.

"If Mars hits the Earth, it will be uncomfortable for us to be caught in the middle."

Du Jian put out his half-smoked cigarette in the ashtray and stood up.

"No, we can't wait."

"Let's go find Zhang Jianto."

"He must be mentally prepared first."

The two of them left the house, walked through the yard, and came to the door of the factory.

Zhang Jian was sitting on a wicker chair in front of the factory, holding a tablet in his hand and swiping his fingers across the screen.

Suleiman came out of the factory with a cup of black tea in his hand and a relaxed expression on his face.

After the fight between Hassan and Lei Zi, the atmosphere between the two sides became less tense.

Seeing Du Jian and Zhao Pingan approaching, Zhang Jian raised his head.

"Captain Du, is the place where you live okay?"

"Very good, thanks."

Du Jian pulled up a chair and sat down, not intending to go around in circles.

"Boss Zhang, there's something I need to talk to you about."

Zhang Jian put down the tablet and placed it on the table.

"Say."

Du Jian crossed his hands on his knees and leaned forward slightly.

"I just had a phone call with China."

"The higher ups take your safety very seriously."

"In addition to our sharp blade team, an additional team has been sent over."

"Calculate the time, we will arrive the night after tomorrow at the latest."

Zhang Jian raised his eyebrows after hearing this.

"Send additional manpower?"

He took the teacup handed over by Suleiman and blew on the hot air.

"That's a good thing."

"There are a lot of people outside looking at me now. I need more manpower and more protection."
